name: cache-key-classification-folding
body: The classification config is folded into the scan cache key. `requirements.requirement.classification-config-in-cache-key` drives `domain.value.cache-key` (the value the classification component folds into) and the narrow entity `domain.entity.classification-config`, which is `realised-by` the narrow component `solution.component.cache-classification-key`. That component is `implemented-by` `rust.apg.cache.manifest.ScanConfigKey`, `rust.apg.cache.manifest.CacheKey.compute`, and `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan`; `domain.entity.classification-config` is driven so coverage reaches those code FQNs. A Value lacks a `realised-by` edge, so the value contributes zero solution; driving `domain.group.graph-identity` pulls the whole of `solution.component.scan-driver` into coverage. The classification helpers `rust.apg.cache.manifest.classification_digest` (`src/cache/manifest.rs:49-62`) and `rust.apg.cache.manifest.classification_render` (`src/cache/manifest.rs:64-94`) are reached through `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan`; the unit test `rust.apg.cache.tests.unit.cache_key_folds_the_classification_config` (`src/cache/tests.rs:191-335`) exercises the folding. The scan blacklist is a separate gap in the same key, documented in the blacklist gap note.
